map_description: The SGV Dullahan is the first ship of the eponymous variant of the original Chase-class light frigate design. Like its predecessor, the Dullahan is designed for rapid and sudden combat operations and is adapted for extended missions without resupply. The main difference from earlier models is a controversial complete redesign of the ship’s bow and the replacement of experimental energy weapons with more suitable ballistic alternatives. The Dullahan differs from other similar ships in service in its high level of automation and the fault tolerance of its combat systems, which is a hallmark of many vessels built by Positronic Shipyards.
equipment: 1 modified class IV nuclear storm drive
